description: This file defines a React page component for watching a video by ID, fetching and rendering video details and recommendations asynchronously using Next.js features.

methods.name: VideoSection
methods.description: Fetches video details by ID and renders video player and meta information; triggers notFound if the video does not exist.

methods.name: RecommendationsSection
methods.description: Fetches recommended videos based on current video ID and renders sidebar recommendations.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Main async component that orchestrates rendering the video section and recommendations within a responsive layout for a specific video ID.
